typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source slide 6 / heading.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source slide 6 / boundary.

recognitionRules: Use a plain Arial headline with Georgia supporting narrative.
Keep warm paper and brown editorial accents quiet around the artifact.
Give the author’s role a distinct line near the opening.
Show the shared sheet or prototype beside the principle it demonstrates.

principles: Name the work and the contribution before describing personal qualities.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Make the handoff visible enough for someone else to continue.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid unsupported expertise labels and turning prototypes into shipped outcomes.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: I made this part; the team decided what happened next.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use HANDOFF NOTES in Georgia with an Arial case identifier and a short open-ended rule. No passing-hands icon.
invariants: Use a plain Arial headline with Georgia supporting narrative.
Keep warm paper and brown editorial accents quiet around the artifact.
Give the author’s role a distinct line near the opening.
adaptations: A short case retains role, artifact and next-step logic.
An operations version replaces narrative paragraphs with owner and action fields.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Georgia is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.
Arial is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
